newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African stocks end steady after choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: South African stocks end steady after choppy trade.

text.p: South African shares returned to just below their previous closing levels at the end of trade on Monday after a day of choppy dealings.
After beginning the day softer on fresh lows in bullion, gold stocks ended steady propped up by a weaker rand, which slid over four cents against the dollar on Monday.
The gold index finished 0.7 points weaker at 1,523.4.
Industrial shares ended a touch weaker, but off their lowest levels reached when the rand lost ground, after initially being boosted by arbitrage trading between the futures and spot markets.
The industrial index finished 4.7 points down at 7,992.8, after at one stage being up over 35 points.
Gold stocks were expected to soften on Tuesday if bullion probed below the $370 level, while industrials were seen losing ground on an ailing rand.
